name: Forbidden Vigilante Knowledge
body:
You delve into powers beyond the capacity of other dilettantes and dabblers.

Prerequisite: Magical limit break vigilante talent, spellcasting class ability which removes access to spells.

Benefit(s): You are treated as though the 7th level spells of your spell list were on your spell list (a cabalist would gain access to 7th level witch spells).

Special: If you select the magical limit break vigilante talent a second time, you also treat 8th level spells of your spell list as though they were on your spell list.
